Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 94. Category: form. Majin Mark.

Power-Up
A power-up fueled by dark magic and mind control.
Increase your Power by 1
Increase your Movement Speed by 10 ft.
At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Stamina
This Power-Up is considered active until dispelled.
The giver of this mark may attempt to control the
afflicted a number of times per day equal to their
Wisdom modifier. While under control the giver can
decide how much control to leave to the afflicted even to
the point of fully controlling them until the afflicted can
pass the wisdom save. The afflicted make the save once
every number of rounds equal to the giver’s Wisdom
modifier
